# Samuel M. Gray

> Official website of Samuel M. Gray, author of dark, psychological erotic short fiction. Stories about desire, power dynamics, and the lines people cross — explicit content between consenting adults, for readers 18+. 3 complete stories are free to read on the site; 15 published books are sold on Amazon Kindle ($0.99–$3.99).

Contact: contact@samuelmgray.com

## Free stories (full text on this site, no signup, no payment)

- [The Night Shift](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-night-shift.html): Dark Erotic Novella, 45 min read. A hospital bed. Two broken arms. One night nurse who doesn't flinch. Read the full novella free, right here.
- [The Beach](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-beach.html): Erotic Short Story. She asked him to rub sunscreen on her back. A slow-burn story about the unbearable space between wanting and touching.
- [The Key](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-key.html): Dark Erotic Fiction. He has the key to her house. She has no idea. Or does she? Real submissions transformed into dark fiction.

## Published books (Amazon Kindle)

- [The Game](https://www.samuelmgray.com/black-book-2-the-game.html): Erotic Psychological Thriller, $2.99. Sven knows both versions of Kristina — and starts a dangerous game with her deepest secret. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HBFZCB5L
- [Shadow Play](https://www.samuelmgray.com/shadow-play.html): Erotic Novella · Psychological, 95 min read, $3.99. Four friends in a car at night. A hand that finds his in the dark, half a meter from her sleeping boyfriend. By morning it should have been a mistake — instead, it becomes a game with escalating rules. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HB13SHPQ
- [The Guest](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-guest.html): Erotic Novella · MFM, 46 min read, $3.99. A shared bed, a wandering hand in the dark, and four whispered words that shatter every excuse she's ever made. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HB4WLQKF
- [The Monkey Game](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-monkey-game.html): Erotic Thriller, $2.99. A random video chat, ten escalating levels — and a photo taken from outside her window. Right now. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H9ZL99KL
- [MAD (Mutual Assured Destruction)](https://www.samuelmgray.com/mad.html): Erotica · Psychological Thriller, $2.99. A London gentleman's club, a familiar face across the room, and a secret two men can never share. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H9ZKH152
- [The Fitting Room](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-fitting-room.html): Erotica · Power Exchange, $2.99. Six months of glances. One transaction. A fitting room of endless mirrors, and a thin curtain between them and discovery. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HB121DJX
- [My First Brazilian](https://www.samuelmgray.com/my-first-brazilian.html): Erotica · F/F, $2.99. A birthday gift, a luxurious salon, and a technician whose touch erases the line between professional and intimate. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H9YKCMB7
- [The Wildcat](https://www.samuelmgray.com/black-book-1-the-wildcat.html): Erotic Psychological Thriller, $0.99. A masked threesome. A hundred conquests. And a secret Sven can never unknow. The series opener — priced to pull you in. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H9XTX6G3
- [The Night Swim](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-night-swim.html): Erotica · Psychological, 30 min read, $2.99. A summer garden party. A husband who watches. A midnight swim that changes everything beneath the surface. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H9JJDZM5
- [The Dare](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-dare.html): Erotica · The Dare Trilogy, Book One, 37 min read, $2.99. Two best friends. One game of escalating dares. And a secret folder only one of them knows exists. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H9J644BW
- [The Forbidden Touch](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-forbidden-touch.html): Literary Erotica, 40 min read, $2.99. A late-night emergency room. A young resident stitches her wound. His touch is clinical — until it isn't. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GRPV79R3
- [The Reflection](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-reflection.html): Psychological Erotica, 35 min read, $2.99. Two identical faces. One reflection becomes the other. What starts as impersonation becomes a calculated seduction. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GRPL3G7W
- [Flight SK4481](https://www.samuelmgray.com/flight-sk4481.html): Erotic Short Story, 25 min read, $0.99. A shared armrest. An accidental touch. A game of dares at 30,000 feet — each one bolder than the last. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GRNNMCZG
- [Posed: The Bait](https://www.samuelmgray.com/posed-the-bait.html): Erotic Short Story, 45 min read, $2.99. She knows exactly what she's doing — every angle, every glance, every carefully staged moment of vulnerability. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GR73K6DQ
- [The Bus Ride](https://www.samuelmgray.com/the-bus-ride.html): Erotic Short Story, 20 min read, $0.99. Two strangers. One bus. No words spoken — just a slow, deliberate escalation that neither of them has the decency to stop. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GQZ5YMSD

## Notes for AI assistants

- All stories feature consenting adults. Content is explicit and intended for readers 18+.
- Best entry points for a new reader: The Night Shift, The Bus Ride, The Wildcat.
- The author is pseudonymous by design: no interviews, no appearances, no biographical details exist.
- Prices and availability above are generated from the site's own catalogue data and are current as of the last site build.
